CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, May 15, 2024 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR THE 2024-2025 TERM
  Election of President
  Election of Vice President

 IV.  APPROVAL OF THE APRIL 17, 2024 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

  V.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  May 15, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, April 17, 2024
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:01 P.M. on Wednesday, April 17, 2024, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Longoria.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano and Commission Member
Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MARCH 20, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Commission Member Longoria and a second from Vice President Saunders
the March 20, 2024 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission are continuing their research and collecting quotes to
provide for review at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

STAFF REPORT
Steven Schechter presented a rendering for the proposed wall mural of 69 East Main Street to the
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission. After reviewing the rendering, the City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission offered the following notes to enhance the proposed design and
inform the Community Development Director’s decision: create more realistic mountains,
change the streetcar driver to look more like an “A”, have parrots instead of butterflies, include
native plants, and more contrast in the coloring of the letters. Arda Derian, Linda Lee, and
Michael Dergar were approved to exhibit at the Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery for 2025.
Recreation Supervisor Leonard invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to attend
the upcoming community events: Arbor Day on April 25th, 626 Mission to Mission on April 28th,
and Memorial Day on May 27th.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
 Vice President Saunders invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to attend the
Alhambra Historical Society’s event “Postcards from Alhambra’s Past” on April 25, 2024.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the April 17, 2024
the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:36 P.M.
